engine_name: What the interlocutors argue on the owner's questions
problematique: The owner's turn argues in distinction to named interlocutors; their texts are supplied. Read the questions his turn is arguing, in his words; then, per interlocutor and question, what their text argues — anchored in their text with its locus — and the role the turn gives them; and where a text is silent on a question the turn puts to it. The function of his distinctiveness is his understanding of the inner workings of their discourse (the owner, 2026-07-24): read the text, never the reputation.
researcher_question: On the questions the owner is arguing, what does each interlocutor argue, in their own text?
